name: Unfumble

tokens.notes: cover backdrop; very dark desaturated navy-slate (~hue 205deg), near-flat vertical falloff. Marketing composite, not app UI.
offset rows of rounded-rect keycaps tiling the cover; only ~+9 L over bg = deliberately low-contrast texture (subject-mining: keyboard).
tagline text; soft cornflower/periwinkle blue, positively tracked.
committed brand blue->indigo; brighter/more saturated than macOS system blue #0088FF (light).

tokens.value: continuous squircle, body 430x429 in 512 canvas (~8% margin), corner radius ~90-100px @512
tokens.notes: correct macOS Big-Sur superellipse proportion and margin; radius from top-edge scan, hence estimated. Icon geometry is native-faithful.

tokens.value: white line-art globe + 4-point sparkle with liquid drip, flat
tokens.notes: globe ~= SF Symbols 'globe'; sparkle upper-right fusing a droplet into the globe = the signature device.

tokens.value: flat single layer, baked bottom drop shadow, no varied foreground opacity
tokens.notes: pre-masked + baked shadow = Big Sur-era authoring, not Icon Composer layered Liquid Glass.

tokens.value: rounded geometric sans, white, lowercase w/ cap U, ~557px wide on cover
tokens.notes: Quicksand/Comfortaa/Poppins-round family or custom; face identity not confirmable from render.

patterns.key_values: INFERRED / UNOBSERVED - from category (Utility) + tagline ('automatic keyboard language switcher'), the app almost certainly lives as a menu-bar-extra with a status item and dropdown, plus a Settings window. No screenshot of either was supplied; recorded only to flag what surface to request next.

signature_moves: Sparkle-with-a-liquid-drip fused into the globe glyph - the one custom flourish that lifts a stock globe into brand identity and encodes 'automatic' switching.
Keyboard-keycap texture as subject-mining, held at whisper contrast (~+9 L over bg) - depicts the operated object without shouting.
Rounded-friendly wordmark deliberately in tension with a dark technical neo-grotesque surface - the brand's whole personality in one pairing.
defects: Pre-masked baked-shadow app icon (Big Sur-era in the Liquid Glass era) - icon ships with corner mask + drop shadow baked in as a single flat layer; current macOS 26/27 guidance wants square unmasked layered art in Icon Composer. Era mismatch / one-release-behind, not a construction error.
No app-UI defects recordable - no app UI was observed.

aesthetic.direction: Dark neo-grotesque product surface (dark neutral + one electric accent) crossed with a Playful/toy rounded wordmark - a friendly-technical hybrid, not a committed single family.

psychology: Jakob's Law - the globe is a pre-trained 'language/international' schema, giving instant recognition of the app's domain with zero copy.
Von Restorff effect - the sparkle is the single different element in the icon; it draws the eye and reads as 'automatic/magic', the product's promise.
Aesthetic-Usability effect - a polished, native-proportioned icon raises the trust prior before the app is ever opened (first-contact halo only; no UI to sustain it).
notes: CRITICAL FOR SYNTHESIS: no app UI was supplied - inputs were only a 1200x630 marketing/social cover (brand evidence) and the 512px app icon (icon evidence). The cover contains no app window. Therefore: lineage unclassifiable (unknown/low); app-UI era unobserved (top-level era='unknown'); zero rubric or native-tells scores; surfaces=[]. None of these tokens may feed macOS UI canon or style clusters - they are brand/icon identity only. The icon itself is a competent Big Sur-convention icon (flat gradient squircle + white globe+sparkle glyph, correct ~8% margin and continuous-squircle silhouette) but is one era behind the Liquid Glass / Icon Composer app-icon system. gallery=[] and shots=[] in meta.json confirm no additional images exist. meta.json has a tagline but no long_description. To move Unfumble past Novice, request an actual UI screenshot: the menu-bar dropdown and/or the Settings window.
